name: Breakstone's Cottage Doubles Blueberry (Fruit Seed WARNING)
whyItWorks: The fruit side cup contains whole blueberry preserves with intact tough skins and microscopic seeds. Insoluble blueberry skins can irritate inflamed mucosa, while the whole milk curds retain residual lactose.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose plain cottage cheese and stir in smooth, seedless fruit purees at home.
